description: For "Not configured", "Session expired" or "Write access is disabled": opens a page on this computer where the USER logs in to Telegram (QR code, 2FA password) and chooses what you may do (read-only, ask before each write, or write freely). Returns the page link: give it to the user and wait for them. You never see their code or password, and you never choose the mode for them. Calling it again returns the same page while it is open.
name: telegram_setup

exitCode.description: The CLI's exit code (0 ok, 1 runtime, 2 usage, 4 writes off, 5 not logged in)

output.description: The result as the model reads it: the command's output (its JSON as text with --json), an error or what to do next. The same text as content.

status.description: approval_required, human_required, nothing_to_do, done, open_page or ready

stderr.description: What the CLI printed on stderr

title: Set up Telegram (for the user)
